notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one green creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a green creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Ivy Lane Denizen trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Ivy Lane Denizen trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.
